name: Multisync — Sync external data to custom fields to turn static sites into dynamic hubs
author: MULTIDOTS Inc

sections.description:
If your WordPress site relies on external data — product feeds, inventory, listings, or blog content from third-party APIs — manually updating it wastes hours every week.

Multisync connects your WordPress posts directly to external data sources and keeps them automatically updated on a schedule you set, without touching a line of code.

Key Features

  • Connect Any External Data Source: Add your API endpoint and credentials — Multisync handles the connection with no code required.
  • Automated Sync Scheduling: Set syncs to run hourly, daily, or at any interval. Content updates in the background, automatically.
  • Custom Post Field Mapping: Map external data — titles, images, prices, inventory — to the exact post fields where they belong.
  • Eliminate Manual Data Entry: Post creation and updates happen automatically, turning a recurring task into a one-time setup.
  • Works Across Multiple Use Cases: Products, listings, job posts, news feeds — Multisync adapts to your data structure and content type.

Who Is It For?

Multisync is built for WordPress site owners, developers, and store managers who pull content from external sources and are tired of manually updating it.
If you manage product feeds, aggregated listings, or any site where content lives outside WordPress but needs to appear inside it,
Multisync handles the bridge — automatically, accurately, and on your schedule. The free version gives you everything you need to start syncing immediately.

Why Choose the Smart Post Sync Plugin?

  • Simplified Integration: Multisync simplifies API integrations, offering an easy setup and a user-friendly interface that lets you sync external data effortlessly.
  • Save Time and Effort: Automate post creation and updates, eliminating manual data entry and saving valuable time.
  • Maintain Accuracy: With customizable post mapping, ensure that the right data is pulled into the correct post elements, keeping your content organized and accurate.
  • Stay Updated: Set automated sync intervals to keep your website’s content fresh and relevant without manual intervention.
  • Enhanced Flexibility: Whether you’re syncing product details, blog content, or other external data, Multisync adapts to your unique needs, providing a reliable solution for diverse use cases.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-post-sync directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Set up your API connections through the plugin settings page to start syncing data into your posts.
sections.faq:
What is Multisync and what does it do?

Multisync connects your WordPress site to external data sources via API and automatically creates or updates posts with the imported data. Once configured, it runs on the schedule you set — no manual work required.

Do I need coding or technical skills to use Multisync?

No. You enter your API credentials, configure your field mapping, set your sync schedule, and the plugin handles everything else.

How do I set up an API connection?

Go to the plugin’s settings page and click “Add API Connection.” Enter your API credentials and configure your data mapping settings to start importing content into your posts.

What types of data can I sync?

Any data your API provides — product titles, descriptions, images, prices, inventory levels, blog content, job listings, real estate data, and more. If your API returns it, Multisync can map it to a post field.

How often does Multisync sync my data?

You set the interval — hourly, daily, or a custom schedule. Multisync runs automatically in the background at the frequency you choose.

Can I sync data manually?

Yes. A manual sync option is available under the Attribute Mapping tab whenever you need an immediate update outside your scheduled intervals.

Will Multisync overwrite content I’ve edited manually?

No. Multisync only updates the fields you’ve mapped. Any content outside those fields remains unchanged.

What happens if the API connection fails?

Multisync notifies you of the failure so you can update your credentials or check the external service. Existing posts remain untouched until the connection is restored.

Is Multisync compatible with all APIs?

Multisync works with a wide range of APIs. Compatibility depends on the API structure — ensure your external API delivers data in a supported format for best results.

Is Multisync compatible with WooCommerce and custom post types?

Yes. Multisync works with standard WordPress posts, WooCommerce products, and custom post types.

How do I get support?

Post your question on the WordPress.org support forum for the plugin and the Multidots team will assist you.
